## Precursor-decay scale qualification before a new kinetic loss

A remaining intact-substrate signal could constrain degradation rate, but only if its scale is comparable across acquisitions. The current product/substrate recipe cancels shared run gain; adding uncalibrated intact intensity does not automatically recover that gain.

The original [PXD058121 Methods](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11874349/) describe automatic gain control, maximum accumulation time, acquisition-wide spectrum averaging and Xtract intensity output. Those protocol settings do not establish the actual per-scan scaling of each processed quantity. Preserve literal settings, including the reported ID-MS AGC target, without silently correcting or interpreting them as measured injection times.

Please qualify compact metadata/processed exports for:

1. Original RAW acquisition → scan set → averaged spectrum → processed input-mass/assignment links, with actual accumulation times, AGC settings/behavior and scan inclusion.
2. The exact intensity definition, deconvolution charge/envelope aggregation, averaging rule and any gain, base-peak, total-signal or injection-time normalization. Unknown normalization must remain unknown; this request does not assert that a particular normalization was used.
3. Any independent stable reference with its amount, spike stage and acquisition links, or independently calibrated residual-substrate measurements and uncertainty. The sum of listed deconvoluted intensities is not automatically TIC or a mass standard.
4. Existing homogeneous context/calibration fields distinguishing protocol claims from per-acquisition observations. A future recipe must replay amount/normalizer joins and applicability; do not infer the normalizer from the precursor/product signals it would train on or divide by accumulation time without a supported signal definition.

This extends the open calibration/preparation request here; it is separate from peptide-specific MS-response calibration in #762. No vendor spectra were reprocessed, new time-course values read, precursor-decay target admitted, or model fitted. The [methods-only assessment](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/codex/modular-presto-model-20261020/tasks/intact-precursor-scale-assessment.md) records the gain/decay ambiguity and admission boundary; publication is being batched with the pending source report after current CI.
